name: Rog'mar Supplies
summary: A local contact asks you to hinder Rog'mar by taking supply shipments from the training grounds north of camp. The delay could leave Horde forces less ready for battle.

sections.title: A Supply Shortage
sections.body: A contact near Rog'mar sees a chance to slow the orcs' growth. You are asked to take their supply shipments from the training grounds north of Rog'mar. Supply deliveries here are difficult, and the theft is meant to delay the Horde's preparations for battle.

faq.q: What am I being asked to do?
faq.answer: You are asked to take Horde supply shipments from the training camps north of Rog'mar.
The theft is intended to delay Rog'mar's growth and keep Horde forces from being as ready for battle.
The Horde supply shipments are at the training camps north of Rog'mar.
